_comment: The admitted measure sources. A PR that adds or bumps an entry is how a measure enters Penlight; the tag + sha256 pins are what the pipeline downloads. Entries with pending_release are read from local checkouts until their first tagged release.

measures.name: sunscore
measures.notes: Street-level sun access from the 2022 Cook County LiDAR DSM; 18 m grid. Nominated by Jackie Schmitz, 43rd Ward.

measures.name: parkability
measures.notes: Ward values still come from the repo's own ward summary; two fixed-geography metrics stay ward-only.

measures.name: rentrate
measures.notes: Cook County parcels; the absentee layer is the full 1.6 M parcels (216 MB) — a release should publish the documented parcel-digit sample instead.

measures.name: microhappiness
measures.notes: Synthetic small-area estimates (GSS × ACS/PLACES MRP), nationwide tracts + ZCTAs; labeled modeled, never observed.
